description: BeatWave 6.0.0 — major release introducing Dynamic Spotify recommendations on play, BeatWave Sync collaborative playlists & realtime chat, one-tap custom Theme Presets, and SoundCloud-style Music Presets.

changelog.title: BeatWave Sync & Collaborative Rooms
items: BeatWave Sync: Shareable invite links (https://beatwave.de5.net/sync/{roomCode}) to listen together in real time.
Collaborative shared playlists: add and remove songs with friends and save room queues directly to your playlists with one tap.
In-room real-time chat with member badges, reply support, and timestamps.

changelog.title: Smart Discovery & Spotify Recommendations
items: Dynamic Spotify recommendations: instantly calculates and suggests fresh tracks seeded by your last played song under 'Because You Listened To'.
Recommendation Engine Selector: switch between Spotify algorithmic intelligence and YouTube Music in Content & Spotify settings.
Smooth fallback to related artist & album mixes.

changelog.title: Custom Glass Theme Presets
items: One-tap Theme Presets: Deep Midnight OLED, Cyberpunk Neon, Emerald Frosted Glass, Rose Gold, Sunset Amber, and Dynamic Material You.
Live gradient preview tiles and instant whole-app theme adaptation.

changelog.title: Music Presets & Audio Polish
items: One-tap playback presets: Normal, Sped Up (1.25x), Nightcore (+3 semitones), Slowed (0.85x), Daycore (-3 semitones), and Vaporwave (-4 semitones).
Accessible from both the Player Menu and 3-dot Song Options.
First-launch login onboarding for YouTube Music and Spotify accounts.
